'''Mollie's Chansey''' (Japanese: '''モリーのラッキー''' ''Mory's Lucky'') is [[Mollie]]'s first known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. She is often seen [[Walking Pokémon|outside]] of her {{i|Poké Ball}}.

==History==
[[File:Chansey and Rockruff.png|thumb|left|250px|Chansey and [[Murdock's Rockruff]] ready to battle]]
{{p|Chansey}} debuted in ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]'' by helping [[Liko]] when she almost fell over from the weight of the boxes she was carrying. Once Liko ran off to look for her missing {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}, Chansey was left to carry the boxes, almost dropping them due to Liko running off abruptly. 

In ''[[HZ005|Found You, Fuecoco!]]'', Chansey briefly battled against [[Zirc]]'s {{p|Rhydon}} after [[Orla]] and [[Murdock]] returned to the [[Brave Olivine]] to fix up its balloon gasbag. Chansey rushed towards Rhydon with {{m|Pound}}, but was taken down by Rhydon's {{m|Rock Blast}}, after which [[Roy]] and {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}} stepped up to battle Rhydon. 
[[File:Mollie and Chansey.png|thumb|250px|Chansey and Mollie]]
In ''[[HZ011|Arboliva's Forest]]'', Chansey helped Mollie treat a {{rf|Paldean}} {{p|Wooper}} whose {{type|Grass}} Pokémon friends were preventing Liko from doing so, afraid that she was trying to harm them, although Chansey and Mollie were successful in convincing them otherwise.

In ''[[HZ032|Lapras's Feelings for its Friends]]'', Chansey and [[Murdock's Rockruff]] joined forces to fend off the attacking Pokémon sent by [[Lucius's Lapras]] who were trying to steal their supplies. While intimidated at first, Chansey and Rockruff nevertheless pushed through to defend their airship, with Chansey focusing on {{p|Octillery}} while Rockruff battled {{p|Barbaracle}}.

In ''[[HZ038|The SOS is from Tandemaus?]]'', Chansey helped Mollie give the Pokémon living at the Brave Olivine a routine check-up, and once [[Friede's Charizard]] came in, completely exhausted by helping the airship fly through a storm, Chansey gave it her egg to allow Charizard to regain its strength. She also helped heal {{p|Shuckle}} with {{m|Heal Pulse}} after it had gotten hurt by a thorn. Her actions also inspired [[Liko's Hatenna]] to learn Heal Pulse. Later, Chansey helped Mollie treat what they assumed was a {{p|Tandemaus}}, but it later turned out to be a family of four {{p|Maushold}}, with Hatenna mastering Heal Pulse to help treat them.

In [[HZ134]], Chansey worked alongside her crewmates to limit the effects of [[Laquium]] infecting the [[Pokémon]] of [[Pericarp Town]].

==Personality and characteristics==
[[File:Chansey nurse.png|thumb|250px|left|Chansey's determination to treat an injured {{P|Wooper}}]]
Much like the rest of her {{p|Chansey|species}}, Chansey is kind and caring towards both {{pkmn|Trainer}}s and Pokémon. Due to [[Mollie]]'s duties as the doctor of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]], Chansey likewise assists her Trainer in helping others with any illness or injuries they might suffer. This also extends towards [[wild Pokémon]], as seen in ''[[HZ011|Arboliva's Forest]]'', when she helped Mollie treat a {{rf|Paldean}} {{p|Wooper}}. This was shown again in ''[[HZ038|The SOS is from Tandemaus?]]'', when she helped treat a wild {{p|Maushold}}. 

Despite rarely doing so, Chansey is able to hold her own in battle, as she helped defend the [[Brave Olivine]] from a pirate group of Pokémon at sea who were looking to steal their supplies. Nevertheless, her power has limits, as she wasn't able to measure up against [[Zirc]]'s {{p|Rhydon}}. Chansey has also shown to act like a big sister towards other Pokémon, such as [[Liko's Hatenna]]. In additon, Chansey dosen't mind when other Pokémon help her, as seen in ''The SOS is from Tandemaus?'', when Hatenna helped her chase a family of Maushold so they could get a checkup. This was shown again in ''[[HZ068|Into a New Sky! The Brave Olivine!]]'', when {{p|Hattrem}} used {{m|Heal Pulse}} with her to heal various Pokémon.
